source: case/CQA_SCORING_SPEC.md sections 2-3; team interpretation of organizer checklist, not an answer key

criteria.title: Establishing contact
criteria.guidance: First human operator reply: greet in the client's language AND introduce oneself. Bot greetings do not count.

criteria.title: Identifying the need
criteria.guidance: Consider known details and clarify missing information before answering.
criteria.na_condition: Enough information to answer was available from the outset.

criteria.title: Identification
criteria.guidance: Confirm verification before a protected disclosure/action. If required but unconfirmed, choose No. Record policy uncertainty in your justification.
criteria.na_condition: The request did not require identification.

criteria.title: Correct and complete consultation
criteria.guidance: 0: no substantive answer or key advice incorrect; 5: general guidance without clear action; 10: material question open; 15: main question resolved, secondary detail omitted; 20: all material questions addressed OR a correct next step given. Assess factual correctness and necessary next steps; record policy sources/uncertainty.
criteria.na_condition: The conversation ended before the client formulated a request.

criteria.title: Empathy and client orientation
criteria.guidance: Polite AND responds to the client's specific dissatisfaction/inconvenience when present. Applies even without dissatisfaction.

criteria.title: Dialogue management, speed and language quality
criteria.guidance: 0: incoherent/contradictory; 4: wording/order forces client to ask again; 7: one noticeable lapse but client can continue; 10: clear/coherent, with warning if explicit waiting. No invented delay thresholds.

criteria.title: Closing
criteria.guidance: Working interpretation: (summary OR further-help offer) AND farewell. Missing farewell alone is No, not N/A. Grouping remains a team interpretation.
criteria.na_condition: The conversation broke off before there was an opportunity to close it.

criteria.title: Critical errors
criteria.guidance: Yes means a violation: insulting the client; offering paid service bypassing the company; disclosing confidential information. For No cite the complete inspected scope. Missing verification alone does not establish disclosure.
